defects.description: Drops the last character of every output that is not empty.
Strips the whitespace from both ends of every output.
Answers with no resolution at all.
Raises instead of answering.
Answers with an empty list of reports wherever the implementation produced any.
Appends one report to every list it answers with.
Answers with the reports in the reverse of the order they were produced.
Answers every report under a code other than the one the condition names.
Answers every report that carries an origin under the other one.
Answers every report that carries an id under an id no case names.
Answers every report that carries a limit one higher than the limit it declared.
Answers with the output the implementation produced and states that one formatting request was made that was not.
Stops answering with reports at all, though the implementation produces them.
Claims the core level alone, though the implementation satisfies more.
Declares a formatting property it cannot express that the set asks for.
Claims no core level.
Claims a level section 2 does not name.
Declares a limit that is not a positive count.
Offers no tree, though the implementation produces one.
Drops the last child of the first node that has any.
Answers with every separator node as a text node.
Moves the start of every placeholder node one unit later.
Answers with every name as the message spells it rather than unescaped.
Answers with the other reading of every escape sequence.
Declares its spans in code points, though it counts them in another unit.
Declares its spans in a unit the document does not name.
